correctness.rationale: Direct full-shell affine images establish exact state-dependent conditional uniformity. Geometric reset shell levels, nearest-neighbor gambler's-ruin probabilities, and the independent reset at any crossing yield N=2G+s. Its finite moments and ΔN=>Exp(2) follow algebraically. Countably repeated certain crossings prove N=∞ at p=1/2. Bernoulli strong law proves almost-sure endpoint rates. A stand-alone exact Fraction checker passed 96 independent finite-time interval-versus-shell comparisons and recurrence/moment checks; finite testing is corroborative only.

originality.rationale: The motivating full primary text explicitly restricts its theorem to the fair selection p=1/2, states that it cannot determine the case p!=1/2, and proves occupation/return limit laws rather than the all-time half-crossing count. The subsequent generalized-core work also fixes equal map-choice probabilities. The present statement is a complete offcritical geometric-parity law with sharp critical crossover, and its exact full-half resetting calculation is not an implication of those occupation laws. Published public mathematical-results index semantic comparisons and the available prior claims gave no statement covering these objects and observables. Classical gambler's ruin is acknowledged as a method, not claimed as new. Residual priority risk from an inaccessible 2019 thesis and differently phrased excursion work remains.
residual_risks: Genji Hata, 2019 Kyoto MSc thesis on a piecewise linear random map is cited by the original paper, but full material could not be obtained in this run; an unpublished equivalent count formula cannot be ruled out.
An equivalent crossing-count formula might be embedded in older gambler's-ruin treatments of random interval maps under different language despite the identified source focusing on fair selection.

value.rationale: This is a natural and nontrivial persistence/transition observable for the canonical Hata random map: the complete count of switches between the two intermittent endpoint basins. It resolves an explicit offcritical parameter gap in the motivating literature, includes exact two-parity laws, divergent mean near balanced selection, endpoint convergence rates, and a universal exponential crossover. None follows just from a standard asymptotic occupation proportion. The finite reset proof is structurally relevant rather than an arbitrary narrow numerical slice.
